column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: cleat#2244's reclaim-race regression test (PR #2815) runs 5 configurations -- postgres, mysql, mysql_read_committed, mssql_rcsi_on, mssql_rcsi_off. This job sets only CLEAT_TEST_DB (Postgres), so postgres RUNS and the other four skip. Pattern is a PREFIX match (no trailing $) rather than an explicit subtest alternation: scripts/check-skips.sh's static cross-check re.search()es this pattern against the BARE function name with no "/subtest" suffix, so an alternation anchored with "/(...)$" can satisfy check-skip-budget.sh (which reads full subtest names) while never matching the bare name check-skips.sh asks about -- measured directly: run 36743958065, job 109985876430, "gated on mysql; missing ledger line for: cluster, multi-db/mssql, test-go/engine" against the alternation version of this exact line.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: same test as the test-go/engine line above, and the cluster job runs ./engine/... against its own dedicated Postgres-only database too. See the test-go/engine line above, including the prefix-match reasoning.

dialect-gated per SUBTEST: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so mysql and mysql_read_committed RUN and the other three (postgres, mssql_rcsi_on, mssql_rcsi_off) skip. Measured on the real failure this line fixes: run 36740664700, job 109974335100 -- the broad /postgres$/ line read 406 against its declared 405 (this test's postgres arm, now claimed by name above instead), and the __UNATTRIBUTED__ remainder read 326 against its 324 allowance (this test's two mssql_rcsi_* arms, now claimed by name above instead of falling through unattributed). See the test-go/engine line above for why the pattern is a bare prefix rather than a subtest alternation.
